definitions: Bruce M. Knauft is an American anthropologist and professor known for his work on Melanesian cultures, particularly the Gebusi people of Papua New Guinea.
He is a recipient of the J.I. Staley Prize for his book "The Gebusi: Lives Transformed in a Rainforest World."
examples: Bruce Knauft's research has significantly contributed to the field of anthropology.
Students often cite Bruce Knauft in their studies of Papua New Guinea.
The work of Bruce Knauft provides deep insights into cultural change.
